aiResearchSummary.text: Rejuvenation Technologies is researching lipid nanoparticle compositions for the delivery of therapeutic polynucleotides, such as TERT mRNA, to various tissues and cell types, including stem cells and progenitor cells. Their work, as described in 'Compositions and methods for broad delivery of rna to tissue' and 'Compositions and methods for delivery of rna,' focuses on using these formulations for the prevention or treatment of lung disease and fibrosis, highlighting advancements in targeted mRNA delivery.
